shared_elements: shallow incised/low-relief curvilinear line motifs on a plain stone ground
densely packed non-figural (or highly abstracted) ornament covering the field
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, outline-only curvilinear ornament with hooked/spiral terminals arranged with rough bilateral symmetry across an otherwise plain stone field, which is a fairly specific shared convention of drawing by line alone with no infill. However the actual motifs differ: A is dominated by concentric rings/discs, a broad curved band and paired arcs disposed on the back of a body, whereas B shows a large fan or frond-like radiating spray flanked by scroll-and-hook forms, and no motif of one recurs recognisably in the other.
